name: reminder
description: A working turn whose usage lands in the reminder band (context 20,000, reserve 4,000: band 14,401 to 16,000) makes posthorse send one routine task-note reminder as a steer message (src/reminders.ts reminderDecision, src/rollover.ts turn_end). A second turn in the band does not repeat it; the final answer ends the run with none.
